page.overview:
Who is Chief RPM?

Chief RPM is a minor character in Cars. He is Winford Bradford Rutherford's crew chief. He is the brains behind the RPM race team. He always gets spotted because his headphones are never off so he can stay in constant commutation with his team.

"The RPM team's crew chief works closely with Winford Rutherford. It's quite an advantage to have a driver who is an expert in physics."
